reviews.text: As someone with mature, dehydrated skin, I am always cautious about foundations settling into fine lines. This cushion pleasantly surprised me; the 21N Ivory shade blends seamlessly into my skin, providing a natural, 'filter-like' finish without feeling heavy. Despite my skin being dehydrated, it doesn't feel drying throughout the day, though I do recommend prepping the skin well before application. I love that the set includes a mini puff, which is perfect for touch-ups!"
reviews.zh: 我係熟齡兼缺水肌，揀粉底一向都好小心，怕會卡喺細紋入面。呢款氣墊畀到我驚喜：21N Ivory 呢個色號可以好自然咁融入我嘅皮膚，妝效好似「filter」咁又唔覺厚重。雖然我皮膚缺水，但係成日都唔會覺得乾，不過我自己建議上妝之前要做好保濕。鍾意成套仲包埋一個迷你粉撲，方便補妝！"

reviews.text: I’m amazed with this product! The coverage is excellent and you don’t need a lot. I bought two colors because I didn’t know what would work best, found out you can use both and blend. I will buy this again!
reviews.zh: 我對呢件產品好驚喜！遮瑕度超好，而且唔需要用好多。我買咗兩個色號，因為唔知邊個最適合，結果發現可以兩隻溝住用再推開。我一定會再買！

reviews.text: I have red and silver cushions - but this is my favourite! It’s dewy for a really natural finish and left my skin looking flawless. I have mature irish skin and I had no issues using this without the need for powder to “set” it , you don’t need it! Just gorgeous
reviews.zh: 我本身有紅色同銀色嘅氣墊，但係呢款係我最鍾意！佢係水光感嘅，妝效好自然，搽完之後塊面望落好無瑕。我係成熟嘅愛爾蘭肌膚，唔使掃粉去「定妝」都用得到，根本唔需要！真係靚到爆。

reviews.text: I have already tried the Tirtir cushion in the pink case (matte finish) and liked that, so I wanted to try this one as well. I like that this one has a finish that is a tad more satin than the pink case, but not as dewy as the red and silver cases. As usual the coverage is great, but also the product sits on the skin well and feels light. My only caveat is that the product does oxidize some.
reviews.zh: 我之前已經試過 Tirtir 粉紅色盒嗰款（霧面妝效），覺得幾好，所以想試吓呢款。我鍾意呢款嘅妝效比起粉紅色嗰款再 satin 少少，但又未去到紅色同銀色嗰款咁水潤。一如以往遮瑕都好正，而且產品貼服又輕盈。唯一要提嘅係，產品用完會有少少氧化。

reviews.text: The scent is overwhelming. I ordered all the Tirtir product hoping to get the right shades and unscented one. Pls stop using perfume on make up. Perfume should stay as a perfume.
reviews.zh: 香味太衝。我落單買咗 Tirtir 全線產品，希望可以搵到啱色同埋冇香味嗰款。可唔可以唔好喺化妝品入面落香水。香水就應該留返俾香水。

reviews.text: I use the red cushion so wanted to give this one a try. Definitely more semi matte and wore well on a hot day. I bought a shade down since some recommended that and was happy with the match. A little harder to apply evenly than the red cushion. I like the blotting area on the inside of the e cover.
reviews.zh: 我本身用緊紅色嗰款氣墊，所以想試吓呢款。妝效明顯偏向半霧面，喺大熱天底下都捱得住。聽人建議我買咗淺一級嘅色號，結果都幾啱。比起紅色嗰款，呢款比較難搽得均勻。盒蓋內側個吸油位我都幾鍾意。

reviews.text: It has great coverage and does not break around my nose. I have oily and combination skin type. It did start to get oily a bit oily after 4 hours, but when I touched up with powder it still looked great.
reviews.zh: 遮瑕好好，而且鼻邊位都唔會爆。我係油性加混合性肌。4 個鐘之後開始有少少出油，但用粉補一補之後望落仲係好靚。

reviews.text:
No soy experta en cushion y en bases, pero esta es muy linda. La he usado aproximadamente 7 horas y se sigue viendo como cuando la coloqué. Muy linda y me encanta su cobertura.
Tiene un buen tamaño (mi mano mide 17 cm) y no siento una diferencia de tono con la cushion roja (soy N29), además ha combinado muy bien con mi polvo suelto de Givenchy.
reviews.zh:
我唔算係氣墊或者粉底嘅專家，但呢款真係好靚。我用咗大概 7 個鐘，望落同剛搽完嗰陣一樣。非常好睇，我好鍾意佢嘅遮瑕度。
個 size 都幾好（我隻手 17 cm），同紅色嗰款氣墊比較落我都唔覺有色差（我係 N29），同我支 Givenchy 碎粉溝埋一齊用都好夾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
